description: Dataset for Local Communication in Small-Scale PV Systems: Study on Inverter - Smart Meter PLC Communication is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Petr Mlýnek, Karel Bouzek (VUT). This study investigates communication technologies and protocols for small-scale photovoltaic (PV) systems, focusing on the interaction between inverters and smart meters. The research evaluates the performance of Power Line Communication (PLC) technologies, comparing both narrowband (NB-PLC) and broadband (BB-PLC) options. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
